personal_values.note: activity-adapted; UI categories are not validated scale dimensions

notes: STJ inference uses balanced graph coverage, uncertainty-focused adaptive pairing, and regularized Bradley-Terry estimates rather than survivor counts.
Student report presents Top 3 current traits, Top 3 ideal traits, 3 retained traits, 3 growth directions, and Top 3 values.
Report interpretation uses selected Big Five facet-source structure, actual-ideal discrepancy, future-self distance/overlap, and values; it is not a normative Big Five score or diagnosis.
STJ supports administrator-selected adaptive or full-pairwise research modes.
Full mode presents every unique pair once after screening; adaptive mode prioritizes connected coverage and uncertain/close pairs.
Click-to-eliminate semantics are preserved in both modes: clicked item is eliminated; the other is preferred.
